statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-39824 affects golang.org/x/sys only on Windows systems. The vulnerability is in NewNTUnicodeString which is Windows-specific. The only consumer of golang.org/x/sys in the OpenSearch images is the gosu binary in the -dev variant, which is compiled for Linux only, so the Windows code path is not executed.
